Two full tracks at full volume together are loud and muddy: two kicks, two basslines, two sets of hi-hats. **EQ mixing** gives each track
its own space during a blend. The golden rule: **only one bassline at a time.**

## The bass swap

1. Beatmatched and phrased, bring the incoming track in with its **Lo** cut right down. You hear its hats and mids over the outgoing track's full sound.
2. On the first beat of a phrase, swap: incoming **Lo** up, outgoing **Lo** down, at the same moment (one hand on each knob).
3. Over the next 8 or 16 bars take the outgoing track's **Mid** and **Hi** down, then its fader.

## Other transitions

- **Long blend**: both tracks play together for 32 bars or more, EQs moving slowly. House and techno.
- **Filter mix**: sweep the outgoing track's **filter** to a high-pass (it thins out to nothing but hats) while the incoming one comes in,
  or bring the new track in through a low-pass that opens up.
- **Cut**: on the first beat of a phrase, flick the crossfader across. Hip-hop and open-format DJs cut; it's quick and clean if the phrase is right.
- **Echo out**: an echo or delay effect on the last beat of the outgoing track, then cut it; the echo trails off under the new one.
- **Gain first**: before any of these, set both channels' **gain** so the tracks are equally loud. A transition that jumps in volume sounds like a mistake.

## Practise

<div class="dj-tt" data-id="dj-eq" data-a="demo:house124" data-b="demo:house126" data-xf="0.5"></div>

1. Beatmatch B to A (B: about −1.6 %). With B's **Lo** at the bottom (−26 dB, a near kill), start B on a phrase and bring its fader up.
2. On the next phrase, swap the **Lo** knobs. Then fade A out over 8 bars, **Hi** first.
3. Do it again with the **Filter** instead: B in at full EQ but low fader; sweep A's filter to the right (high-pass) over 8 bars while B's fader rises.
4. Try a **cut**: both decks matched, faders up, crossfader full A. On the 1 of a phrase, throw the crossfader to B. Set the **Curve** towards
   "cut" and try again: in the middle both channels are now at full, and the change happens only at the very ends.

| | [Serato DJ Pro](https://serato.com/dj/pro/downloads) | [rekordbox](https://rekordbox.com/en/download/) | [Traktor Pro](https://www.native-instruments.com/en/support/downloads/) |

| EQ and filter | Mixer EQ (on the controller or mixer), Filter knob | EQ, COLOR / Sound Color FX filter | EQ (several types, set in Preferences), Filter |
| Echo out | FX: Echo, with Tap / beat setting | Beat FX: Echo | FX: Delay / Echo |
| Crossfader curve | Setup → Mixer (or on the hardware) | Crossfader curve on the mixer / Preferences | Preferences → Mixer → Crossfader curve |
